family_reports.body: This is the most corrupt legal system here in Northwest Missouri. The good ol boys club is alive and well. There's so many more bad actors that I need to add but need to come back as this has already taken me several hours. I hope I can up date later. They all deserve to be in prison. The ones supposed to uphold the law are the ones breaking it daily!!!

Ripped my son completely away from his home and ALL of his family and ordered him to move to Alaska with strangers. (His father and step mom) My son was a 4.0 student and now barely passing his freshman year of high school due to the forced move. We will never trust any court official ever again.
